text:
sarah.ng: Quick heads-up — planning to cut SDK v4.0 RC tomorrow morning. Major items: auth header shape changes, default retry/backoff behavior changed, streaming framing events updated, and sync client deprecated. Need quick alignment on migration guidance and release checklist.

ajay: Do we have a clear compatibility matrix? e.g., which server-side API versions will accept the old auth?

sarah.ng: Server will continue accepting old bearer token header for 30 days with a deprecation warning in responses. After that we'll enforce the new `x-rdinfer-token` header. Need docs + examples to show swap.

tomas: For retries: we changed default retry to idempotent-only (no automatic retry on POST-like generation calls) and introduced `auto_retry: "conservative"|"aggressive"` config. Migration note should show how to set previous behavior: `client = RedwoodClient(auto_retry="aggressive")`.

sarah.ng: Good — add a code snippet for Python and JS. Also consider a feature flag `RD_ALLOW_LEGACY_RETRY` for Dedicated customers who need extra runway.

lee: Streaming changes: we now emit `event: token` frames instead of mixing `partial`/`done`. That breaks a few integrations that parsed raw chunks. We should include a small codemod snippet and a Node example using the new `for await (const ev of client.stream(...))` pattern.

pm-jen: Timeline question — how long will we keep the sync client code path? we need at least 45 days for enterprise to opt-in migration.

sarah.ng: Deprecation window: 45 days for sync client; 30 days for auth header; 60 days for retry semantics for Dedicated customers if they set the env flag.

kevin: Ping for release tasks:
- update changelog (I can draft)
- publish python & js samples in docs repo (maria.docs?)
- codemod script for TypeScript (I can write a first pass)
- compatibility tests in CI (tomas/qa-bot)

maria.docs: I can take the docs PR. Can we get clear example blocks? for Python: show old -> new auth example and the retry switch.

kevin: Example snippets (feel free to polish):
```python
# old
from redwood import Client
c = Client(api_key=os.getenv("REDWOOD_KEY"))
resp = c.generate("...")

# new
from redwood import RedwoodClient
c = RedwoodClient(auth_header_name="x-rdinfer-token", api_key=os.getenv("REDWOOD_KEY"), auto_retry="conservative")
for chunk in c.stream("..."):
    print(chunk.data)
```

```javascript
// old
const r = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY })
await r.generate(...)

// new
const r = new RedwoodClient({ authHeader: 'x-rdinfer-token', apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY, autoRetry: 'conservative' })
for await (const ev of r.stream(...)) {
  if (ev.type === 'token') console.log(ev.text)
}
```

ajay: Suggest adding a note about token rotation: if customers rotate tokens mid-request we recommend sending `x-rdinfer-request-id` so we can trace and handle token migration in-flight. Also add server-side warning header `x-rdinfer-deprecate` to surface in logs.

tomas: QA: I'll add targeted e2e tests for streaming framing and retry matrices. qa-bot: please schedule regression runs on Dedicated infra with both legacy and new env flags.

qa-bot: scheduled regression job: `sdk-v4-compat` for tomorrow 10:00 UTC against staging. Will post results in #eng-releases.

maria.docs: I'll open docs PR after Kevin's snippets are polished. Can we also include a migration checklist with codemod: replace `.generate(` -> `.createCompletion(`, rename `model` to `modelName`, and change stream handlers from `partial` -> `token` events.

sarah.ng: Good call. Also call out deprecations explicitly in top-level README and add a redirects page for old examples.

kevin: One more thing: changelog format — use Conventional Commits + `BREAKING CHANGE:` blocks for each change so downstream integrators can script alerts.

lee: Anyone opposed to adding a one-click toggle in Dedicated console to allow legacy auth for +30 days? Ops requested it for high-risk customers.

pm-jen: Support OK with that as long as we surface clear expiration and audit logs.

sarah.ng: Ok, action items:
- kevin: draft changelog + codemod PR (today)
- maria.docs: docs PR for migration guide + samples (today -> tomorrow)
- tomas: add CI compat tests + run qa-bot job (tomorrow morning)
- lee: prototype console toggle (POC by end of week)
- ajay: coordinate with infra about server deprecation header (today)

kevin: tagging codeowners: @eng-runtime @devex @docs for reviews. I'll ping in threads once PRs are up. :rocket:

sarah.ng: Thanks team — we'll review RC results tomorrow and decide on GA cadence. If anyone finds small breaking issues, push hotfixes to `release/v4-rc` and notify here.

lee: small note — we should include a short note for customers using third-party SDK wrappers (Go/Java) to either pin older server version or use the toggle. I'll draft an email template for CS.

maria.docs: Draft of docs PR link (WIP): https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/4829 — contains examples, migration checklist, and deprecation timeline. Comments welcome.

kevin: LGTM. I'll start codemod PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pull/1947

ajay: I'll add the `x-rdinfer-deprecate` header implementation in the gateway and post a follow-up here when deployed to staging.

qa-bot: sdk-v4-compat run completed — 1 flaky test in streaming framing. tagging @lee @tomas.

sarah.ng: Thanks. We'll triage the flaky test ASAP. Keep updates here.

kevin: tl;dr summary for CS/email: 30-day auth header deprecation, 45-day sync client deprecation, 60-day optional retry grace for Dedicated. Docs + codemods + examples live in PRs.

pm-jen: Thanks all. I'll coordinate comms and set an in-product banner to show deprecation dates once RC is stable.

sarah.ng: End of thread — please update your PRs and ping when ready.
